in_sanskrit.name: सरो
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The name Saro is derived from the Sanskrit word सरः (sarah), which means 'lake, pond, or body of water'. It is a beautiful and evocative name that conjures images of still, tranquil waters reflecting the world around them.

in_hindi.name: सरो
in_hindi.long_meaning: The name Saro in Hindi is composed of the root word सर (sar), which means 'head' or 'top', and the suffix ो (o), which denotes 'water'. Together, the name means 'water at the top', possibly referring to a body of water that is the highest point in a landscape.

in_tamil.name: சரோ
in_tamil.long_meaning: The name Saro in Tamil is derived from the words கொலம் (kolam), which means 'circle' or 'design', and ஓ (o), which is a vowel sound. The name means 'circle of water' or 'design of water', possibly referring to the way that water forms beautiful patterns and shapes when it is still and undisturbed.

in_telugu.name: శరో
in_telugu.long_meaning: The name Saro in Telugu is composed of the root word శర్ (shar), which means 'head' or 'top', and the suffix ఓ (o), which denotes 'water'. Together, the name means 'water at the top', possibly referring to a body of water that is the highest point in a landscape.

in_marathi.name: Saro
in_marathi.long_meaning: Saro हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The one who comes from the sky or heaven. It is derived from the Sanskrit word 'saras' which means 'lake, pond or body of water'. It is also a name of Lord Indra, the God of rain and thunder, who is believed to dwell in the sky.
